title: Primus Monthly Engineering Report — 2026-10
key_findings: 73 PRs merged to main in the window. Largest categories: CI/Infra 20 (PRPUNDIT test series, v26.6/v26.7 OOB dockerfiles, GPU-label gating), Other 16 (SpecForge offline+online backends, MiniMax-M3, DLRM-v4, model recipes), Bug Fix 12, Performance Optimization 9, Docs 9, Turbo/Dependency Version Update 4, Refactor 3.

No backend-gap-tracked pin changed in-window: third_party/Megatron-LM stayed at d3528a21 and third_party/torchtitan stayed at 73a0e697 (v0.2.2 tag) for the whole window. Therefore backend_gap_updated = false; no backend-gap report was regenerated.

Other in-window pin movement (not backend-gap targets): third_party/maxtext advanced b47d74bf -> b3c53763 (PR #1172, align JAX backends with v26.7). maxtext has no backend-gap report set, so it is noted but not regenerated.

Megatron-LM upstream drift: pin d3528a21 (2026-03-06, unchanged) is now 1662 commits behind upstream HEAD 1b638343 (2026-10-01); upstream core version advanced 0.16.0rc0 (pin) -> 0.20.0. Notable upstream since pin: MFSDP v2 hardening, TransformerEngine 2.20, distributed-optimizer GTP dedup, selective replay for wide-residual streams, hybrid/Mamba + DeepSeek Sparse Attention. Recommendation: plan sync.

torchtitan upstream drift: pin 73a0e697 (v0.2.2, 2026-02-20, unchanged) is now 1194 commits behind upstream HEAD 1aaee42b (2026-10-01). Notable upstream since tag: local compile (OffsetRMSNorm/gated RMSNorm), CUDA-graph optimizer/grad capture, graph_trainer + RL stack, DeepSeek-V4 packed docs/Attention Gym, Qwen 3.5, Tyro->Python config loading. Recommendation: plan sync.

Primus-Turbo Q4 quarterly drift: Q4 began 2026-10-01, only hours before this report, so all tracked pins (CI ae1ac068, benchmark a04a233c, AITER 0f3c58e6, TRITON 09500db9, UCCL 5afb4117) equal their quarter-start values -> 0 commits of Q4 drift. Context: the CI pin advanced 6d5ff979 -> ae1ac068 (+47) during September via PR #1195 (MegaMoE FlyDSL ownership, upstream #525). Recommendation: monitor.

Notable hardening this month: Flux validation-loss clone out of Megatron rescale (#1079), TE requantize_data UnboundLocalError fix (#1108), Triton buffer-store/ROCm NaN workaround (#962), scientific-notation CLI float parsing (#1112), FileNotFoundError (not assert) in setup_backend_path under python -O (#1111), and torchtitan GPT-OSS router-bias init (#1183).
